## Key Features
- Gmail OAuth login/register
- Create multiple birthday albums
- Add memories (images, text, descriptions)
- View album timelines
- Edit/delete memories
- Share albums (future enhancement)

## Technology Stack
- Backend: Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, Passport.js
- Frontend: React, Axios, React Router
- Database: MongoDB Atlas
- Authentication: Google OAuth 2.0
